title: Weighted universal Value-at-Risk Superadditivity for discrete distributions
abstract: arXiv:2609.26398v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The concept of weighted universal Value-at-Risk superadditivity (WUVS) was recently introduced by Chen et al. (2026) as a generalization of the question whether for some infinite mean distributions convex combinations of i.i.d. random variables can stochastically dominate the parent distribution. In this short note we prove that the property WUVS can basically never hold for discrete distributions except for the case of comonotonicity. This implies as a corollary that for discrete distributions with infinite mean it can also never hold that convex combinations of i.i.d. random variables can stochastically dominate the parent distribution. This settles an open problem mentioned in M\"uller (2025).

translated_title: 离散分布的加权普适风险价值超可加性
translated_abstract: 加权普适风险价值超可加性（WUVS）的概念由Chen等人（2026）最近提出，它是对如下问题的一个推广：对于某些无穷均值的分布，独立同分布随机变量的凸组合能否在随机占优意义上支配原分布。在这篇短文中，我们证明了除同单调情形外，WUVS性质对离散分布基本上不可能成立。由此可得一个推论：对于无穷均值的离散分布，独立同分布随机变量的凸组合同样永远无法在随机占优意义上支配原分布。这解决了Müller（2025）中提出的一个开放问题。
tldr: 本文证明加权普适风险价值超可加性（WUVS）除同单调情形外对离散分布基本不成立，并由此推得无穷均值离散分布的独立同分布随机变量凸组合永远无法随机占优原分布，从而解决了Müller（2025）提出的开放问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that weighted universal Value-at-Risk superadditivity (WUVS) essentially never holds for discrete distributions except in the comonotonic case, and as a corollary shows that convex combinations of i.i.d. random variables with infinite-mean discrete distributions can never stochastically dominate the parent distribution, settling an open problem raised by Müller (2025).
